def extract_black_pattern(frame_ascii, r_start, c_start, height=5, width=5):
    lines = frame_ascii.split('\n')
    pattern = []
    for r in range(r_start, r_start + height):
        row = ''
        for c in range(c_start, c_start + width):
            row += '1' if lines[r][c] == 'B' else '0'
        pattern.append(row)
    return tuple(pattern)

initial_ascii = history[0].frame.ascii
grid_positions = {
    (0, 0): (5, 13), (0, 1): (5, 23), (0, 2): (5, 36), (0, 3): (5, 46),

    (2, 0): (23, 13), (2, 1): (23, 23), (2, 2): (23, 36), (2, 3): (23, 46)
}
grid_patterns = {}
for (r, c), (rs, cs) in grid_positions.items():
    grid_patterns[(r, c)] = extract_black_pattern(initial_ascii, rs, cs)

# Cycle 2 more UP to get to state 1 (Grid[2,3])

# Check all pink symbols
